description: This file contains end-to-end tests for the login flow of a web application using Playwright testing framework. It sets up mock API responses, tests UI elements, validation, successful login, error handling, and network error scenarios.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite labeled 'Login Flow'.

methods.name: test.beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up API route mocking and navigates to the login page before each test.

methods.name: test('should display login form')
methods.description: Verifies the visibility of login form elements.

methods.name: test('should show validation errors for empty fields')
methods.description: Checks validation messages when login is attempted with empty fields.

methods.name: test('should login successfully with valid credentials')
methods.description: Performs login with valid credentials and verifies redirection and token storage.

methods.name: test('should show error message for invalid credentials')
methods.description: Performs login with invalid credentials and verifies error message display.

methods.name: test('should handle network errors gracefully')
methods.description: Simulates network failure and verifies error handling.
